---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: "[BUG]"
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
The smallest code, event JSON or relay exchange that shows it.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen, and the NIP or spec section that says so.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Quartz version and artifacts [e.g. quartz-social 1.20.0]:
 - Platform [e.g. Android 15, JVM 21, iOS 18, Linux]:

**Bounty (in Bitcoin sats, non-binding) offered for a solution**
The size of the bounty is proportional to how much this matters to you. If no bounty is offered,
not even a small one, this bug will not be worked on because it doesn't matter to you. We prioritize
bug fixing to issues that have bounties, even small ones.
